title: Drunk Grandma With No License Flees The Scene Of Crash Then Tries Playing Dumb
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On September 5th, 2023. An officer investigated the scene of crash, where a woman crashed her car at a construction site. The woman completely left the scene and was later found walking to her home. The officer approached the woman and she acted clueless as to what happened until officers were able to get it out of her, she was also had a bottle of alcohol on her which she was trying to conceal. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
